answer: Anchor each identity to a jetty queue: admission costs 140 POA locked 70 days and requires clearing 8 dependent tasks in sequence, each unlocked only when a different peer verifies the previous one, so no parallel shortcuts exist. A meadow of shared task history exposes copied outputs, and an inlet of new applicants is capped at one identity per funding source per epoch. A second identity locks 280 POA and faces 16 tasks, a third 560 POA and 32, so queue time, capital and effort all double per fake; auditors verify chain hashes and funding links, slashing 35% of linked stakes for duplicates.
